verdict.rationale: LibreChat runs agents with MCP tools, code execution and API actions, so per-action approval gating is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents no command allowlists, approval prompts before tool or action execution, or opt-in elevated modes. Per-role and per-group configuration overrides and an Access Control page title are adjacent admin controls, not explicit approval of dangerous actions.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, dangerous actions require my explicit approval — command allowlists, approval prompts, and elevated modes that are opt-in per action
